 Home Conor McGregor Conor McGregor vows to ‘take over’ event after last-minute Dillon Danis withdrawal
 Jordan Ellis Mon 2 November 2026 7:00 Follow us on Google Discover Conor McGregor is set to make his first public appearance since losing at UFC 329. 
 ‘Notorious’ instantly blew out his knee when he returned from a five-year layoff in July. 
 It took just 69 seconds for Max Holloway to TKO Conor McGregor in their rematch.
 LATEST NEWS: Watch WingedC drop rival with capoeira kick en route to first professional win 
 What’s next for Conor McGregor after UFC 329?
 'Notorious' suffered a serious knee injury moments into his comeback fight against Max Holloway.
 What’s next for Conor McGregor? Credit: Ian Maule/Getty Images Comment Like or Comment Have your say Sign-in now for free Conor McGregor to attend event in Rome
 Conor McGregor has been keeping a low profile while he recovers from his latest injury setback.
 The former dual-weight UFC champion will step back into the spotlight at an event on Tuesday.
 ‘Mystic Mac’ will travel to Italy to be a special guest at Hype FC’s show in Rome.
 “I’m in Rome this week with my partners, the biggest name in sports betting, @1xbeteng!” McGregor wrote on Instagram .
 “A massive week ahead! Catch me across their scheduled events as we take over Rome in style.
 “We’re coming in BIG. See you all there!”
 Conor McGregor Hype special guest poster. Credit: thenotoriousmma/instagram Who is competing on the card?
 Colby Covington and Dillon Danis were supposed to face off in a submission-only grappling match in the main event of Hype FC’s show in Rome 
 On Sunday, Conor McGregor’s teammate withdrew from the bout on just two days’ notice. 
 UFC bantamweight contender Raul Rosas Jr . stepped into the spot left open by Dillon Danis . 
 It’s currently unclear why Danis withdrew from his clash with Colby Covington at the last minute.
 Check out the full Hype FC Rome card below.
